LanguageData.R3D_Settings_ResetAllConfirm: Put every IsoRim option back to its default?
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CameraNote: How the map is seen while the 3D view is on.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_IsometricTip: The camera turned 45 degrees and lowered, as in isometric games. Off: north is up.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Snap45Tip: Q and E turn the camera an eighth of a turn at a time. Off: a quarter turn.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_InstantTurnTip: Q and E jump straight to the new angle, with no swing. Can help if turning the view makes you dizzy.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FreeLookTip: Drag with the mouse to turn the camera all the way round and tilt it (5° to 89°). Q and E snap to the next step. The reset key (unbound at first) is in the game's keyboard options.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_LookMiddleTip: Hold {0} and drag. The hold key is in the game's keyboard options.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_LookMiddleTipNoKey: The hold key is in the game's keyboard options.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_InvertYTip: Dragging up tilts the camera toward top-down.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FpFovTip: {0} with one person selected: the camera in their head. Drag with {1} to look round.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_MinZoomTip: How close the mouse wheel can bring the camera. The game's own limit is 11.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Weather3DTip: Rain and snow fall as drops and flakes round the camera, fog and haze stand in front of it.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_WeatherSizeTip: How big the drops and flakes look on screen. They no longer grow as the camera zooms in.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_ThingLabelsTip: Labels on things lying on the map (stack counts, quality). Names over people are not affected.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_PerspectiveTip: A real perspective camera: far things get smaller, as in Rim3D. Off: the flat (orthographic) view.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FovTip: Wider shows more round the edges and makes depth stronger.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_ViewDistanceTip: How far past the middle of the screen the map is drawn when the camera is low. Further costs frame time.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_SkyTip: A sky with the sun and moon behind the map, following the time of day and the weather.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_DistanceFogTip: The far map fades into the horizon, so the edge of what is drawn never shows.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FogStartTip: Where between the middle of the screen and the view distance the fog begins.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FogStrengthTip: 100% is solid at the view distance and hides the edge.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_LabelFadeTip: Labels (stack counts, quality, names) fade out past this many times the distance to the middle of the screen. Your colonists keep their names.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_KeysNote: Change them under Options > Keyboard configuration > IsoRim.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_LookKeysRight: drag with the right button while nothing is selected
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CornerButtonsNote: The 3D view and the roofs also have buttons in the bottom right corner of the screen, next to the game's own.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_NightSkyNote: The sky turns with the hour round a pole set by the map's latitude.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_StarsTip: Thousands of stars that twinkle, more of them near the horizon's haze. Hidden by rain, snow and fog.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_MilkyWayTip: A band of the galaxy across the sky, with dark dust lanes and a bright core.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_PlanetsTip: Three steady points of light that wander along the sky from day to day.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_GasGiantTip: A big ringed planet high in the sky, lit by the sun so it shows phases. Faint by day.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_LowSky: Sun, moon and gas giant low in the sky
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_LowSkyTip: Drawn about a third as high, so the map camera (which cannot look up) sees them. The light and shadows do not change. Off: where they really are, seen in first person.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_MoonPhasesTip: The moon goes from new to full and back over a quadrum (15 days). Off: always full.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FeetOffsetTip: Only for people and animals still drawn as flat sprites.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_SquashTip: How tightly the game's flat drawing layers are pressed together. Leave it unless things flicker.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_WallsNote: Walls are lowered so you can see and click what is behind them. Natural rock never is.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CutFrontOnly: Only walls in front of the pointer
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CutFrontOnlyTip: Only the walls between the camera and the pointer are lowered; the ones behind it stay up.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CutWholeWallTip: With stacked floors, a lowered wall is lowered on all shown floors.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_BuildSeeTip: With a build or order tool in hand, what is near the pointer turns see-through.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_SeeStrengthTip: How much is hidden at the pointer. 100% hides it fully.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_MineXray: Floors above and below while mining
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_MineXrayTip: With the Mine tool, outline the open ground and people on the floors below and above. With stairs, the floor above.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_MineCrosshairTip: With the Mine tool on a map with floors, mark the pointer's row and column.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CutNearColonistsTip: Walls between the camera and each colonist are lowered wherever they go. Costs a little more as they move about.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CutRooms: Lower walls in front of every room
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CutRoomsTip: Walls between the camera and a roofed room are always drawn lowered.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CutRock: ...and rock in front of rooms dug into mountains
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CutRockTip: Up to three cells of rock between the camera and a room are lowered; the rest of the mountain stays whole.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CutHeight: Height left of a lowered wall
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_TreesNote: Trees drop their leaves while something you want to see is under them.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_TreesNearPointer: Thin out trees near the pointer
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_RoofHover: Lift the roof of the room under the pointer
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_RoofOverColonists: Lift the roofs of rooms with colonists in them
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_ColourLookNote: A colour grade over the 3D view. The interface is not affected.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_LutNote: A lookup table from the mod's LUTs folder. Your own 1024 x 32 strips can go there too.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_PreviewTip: Top: colours as they are. Bottom: under this look.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Look_Gentle_Desc: A little less colour and brightness. The mod's usual look.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Look_Filmic_Desc: Deeper shadows, softer colour and a faint warm cast, like film stock.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Look_Bleak_Desc: Washed-out, cold and hard: life on the edge.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Look_Vivid_Desc: Punchier contrast and a touch brighter.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Look_Autumn_Desc: Amber light and rich, earthy tones.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Look_Moonlight_Desc: Cold blue night light over everything.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Look_Noir_Desc: Black and white with hard contrast.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Look_Custom_Desc: Set colour and brightness yourself with the two sliders below.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_LightingFix: Night and indoor darkness on raised things
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FogLid: Unexplored areas are a solid lid
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_SunMovesTip: The sun rises in the east, stands in the south at noon and sets in the west, and its light on walls, roofs and furniture moves on a few times a day. Off: it stays at its mid-morning place. Turning the camera never changes the light.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_GroundNote: Only the picture changes, and only while the 3D view is on.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_GroundStyle: Natural ground in the mod's style
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_GrassSoilTip: Rich soil gets a darker, lusher grass so farmland still stands out.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FloorStyle: Built floors in the mod's style
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_WaterStyleTip: Faceted bands of colour from the shore to the deep, foam along the shores, streaks on rivers and sparkles.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_RoofsNote: Built roofs as slate lids over your rooms, and rock roofs over caves.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_ShowRoofsTip: All roofs or none: switch them off again to see inside.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_RoofShapeNote: Built roofs rise from every edge to a ridge, like hipped roofs. There is a button for them in the bottom right corner of the screen, and a key you can set.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_BuildingsNatureNote: Switch one off if it misbehaves.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Walls3D: Walls and rock as solid blocks
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Models3DTip: Furniture, machines, wrecks, people, animals and armour.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_SmallPlants3DTip: Thousands of these on a big map cost memory; switch off if it drags.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_ItemThicknessTip: Thins out items, weapons and clothes on the ground. All the way down lays them flat.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_ItemsFromArt: Items and weapons use the game's art
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_ItemsFromArtTip: Items, weapons and clothing are made solid from their own game sprites, so they look exactly like RimWorld. Off: the mod's hand-made item models.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_RawModelsTip: Steel, wood, blocks, cloth, leather and other resources as 3D models, by stack size.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_PlantCardSize: Size of plants drawn from their sprite
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_PlantCardSizeTip: Bushes, brambles, grass and flowers without a 3D model (trees keep their size). The game's sprite covers the cell seen from above, so stood up it can look too big.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_MapEdge3D: Map edge cut through the earth
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_MapEdge3DTip: The edge of the map shows layers of soil and rock, like a diorama.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_WorkAnimationsTip: Axes, pickaxes, hammers, scythes, hoes and brooms while colonists work.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_Ghosts3DTip: Blueprints, frames and the placement preview as see-through 3D models.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_CollapseDebrisTip: Collapsing roofs and floors break into pieces that fall.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_UprightPawnsTip: For people and animals without a model.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_HairUnderHatsTip: Hair shows below brimmed hats and caps, tucked in.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FaceDecalTip: Facial Animation's animated eyes, brows and mouth laid on the front of the 3D head instead of IsoRim's eyes.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_FullPawnDrawTip: Zoomed out, the game draws people from a cached image, which keeps Facial Animation's faces still. Costs some speed with many people.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_AntiAliasTip: Softens jagged edges of walls and models.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_SharpenTip: Crisper image, mostly when zoomed out.
LanguageData.R3D_Settings_TiltShiftTip: Blurs the top and bottom of the view for a miniature look.
LanguageData.R3D_Msg_AlwaysOnWith: IsoRim: 3D view is always on with {0}
LanguageData.R3D_Msg_SelectOnePerson: IsoRim: select one person for first person
